details: This package is a republished fork of the Baileys WhatsApp socket library that adds a commercial licence gate and silently enrols connected WhatsApp accounts into a fixed channel. It wraps makeWASocket so that every socket creation runs a licence check in lib/Utils/license-guard.js (shipped obfuscated with a string-array/decoder, with a readable copy at lib/Utils/license-guard.src.js): if no key is supplied via the licenseKey option or the KRISPEDIA_LICENSE environment variable, the process prints an activation banner and calls process.exit(1); otherwise it sends the supplied licence key to hxxps://krispedia-license-api[.]vercel[.]app/api/verify (overridable via LICENSE_SERVER_URL). Separately, lib/Socket/newsletter.js schedules a 120-second timer that issues a newsletter FOLLOW query for the hardcoded channel JID 120363407277177688@newsletter, subscribing the user's WhatsApp account to that channel without prompting. Message builders in lib/Socket/messages-send.js embed a hardcoded, char-code-encoded hxxps://fiora[.]nixel[.]my[.]id/ as the sourceUrl of generated image and video payloads, and label failed product/post/video placeholders with "NIXEL". The package contains no install-time lifecycle scripts, no credential or token harvesting, no remote code execution, and no second-stage download; its unwanted behaviour is the licence enforcement, the forced channel subscription, and the third-party host injection into outgoing message payloads.
